month_successor.description: Name the month that follows (or is k months after) a given month. Control: same format with number successor.

numberword_successor.description: Continue a spelled-out English number-word count sequence (e.g. 'seven, eight, nine,' -> ' ten'). Control: identical sequences written with digits.

weekday_successor.description: Continue a weekday sequence (e.g. 'Monday, Tuesday,' -> ' Wednesday'), wrapping Sunday->Monday. Control: same format with digit sequences.

comparative_adjective.description: Form the English comparative of an adjective in a few-shot mapping (e.g. 'tall -> taller, cold -> colder, fast ->' -> ' faster'). Control: same few-shot format but identity mapping (word copied unchanged).

irregular_past_tense.description: Map an English verb to its irregular past tense in few-shot format (e.g. 'eat -> ate, see -> saw, go ->' -> ' went'). Control: same few-shot format with identity mapping.

object_colour.description: Recall the typical colour of an object in few-shot 'object: colour' format (e.g. 'snow: white, grass: green, coal:' -> ' black'). Control: same few-shot format with identity mapping (object copied).

antonym.description: Produce the antonym of a word in few-shot arrow format (e.g. 'hot -> cold, up -> down, big ->' -> ' small'). Control: same format with identity mapping.

pronoun_gender.description: Choose the gendered subject pronoun referring back to a named person (e.g. 'Mary was tired, so' -> ' she'). Control: same sentences, answer is the name repeated ('Mary was tired, so Mary rested. Who rested? Answer:' -> ' Mary').
